description: Fetch metadata and auxiliary views for a Medium topic (https://medium.com/tag/<slug>). section=info (default) returns follower count, post count, and related topics; section=who-to-follow returns the authors and publications Medium recommends for this topic; section=archive returns the chronological story stream, complementing the hot ranking from medium/get-topic-trending. No login required.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic slug, i.e. the last path segment of https://medium.com/tag/<slug>. Discover slugs with: websculpt medium list-topics [--query <name>].

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which view to return: info (topic metadata: followers, post count, related topics; default) | who-to-follow (recommended authors and publications in this topic) | archive (chronological story stream).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries for who-to-follow and archive sections (1-100, default 20). Ignored when section=info.
